messages:
alexa: Quick announce — we just released the Contrib Grants Toolkit v1.0.0 to help community recipients manage award workflows, invoices, and reporting. Release notes + installer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-grants/releases/tag/v1.0.0 :tada:
open-source-bot: Release published: contrib-grants v1.0.0 by @alexa — https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-grants/releases/tag/v1.0.0 (automated)
maya: Great! Does this include the new expense CSV importer?
alexa: Yep — adds CSV importer (mapping UI + preview), a simple approvals flow, and a verifiable receipts attachment field. We also added a lightweight CLI: `rg-grants` for headless installs.
ben: Any breaking changes for existing pilot users?
alexa: No breaking API changes. There is a config key rename though: `grant_admins` -> `maintainers`. We include a tiny migration helper in `scripts/migrate-config.sh`.
alexa: Migration snippet:
```bash
# migration helper
python3 scripts/migrate_config.py --from grant_admins --to maintainers
```
ben: Nice. We'll notify current grantees and run migrations on staging first.
devrel: I'll record a 6-min walkthrough showing the CSV importer and CLI quickstart and post to the community channel. Also drafting a short newsletter blurb.
kyle: For private deployments: any special database migrations?
alexa: Minor DB migration (adds receipts table). The helm chart has a post-install Job that runs migrations automatically. For on-prem folks with strict change windows, see upgrade notes in the release page.
maya: Can we schedule a office-hours for maintainers and grantees next Tue 9am PT? I can host.
devrel: Adding to calendar and community events page. I'll post the join link in #community-calendar.
open-source-bot: New issue created: #121 "add e2e test for CSV importer" by @ben — https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-grants/issues/121
ben: I'll pick that up this week.
alexa: Thanks team and thanks to everyone who contributed — huge props to @maya for the importer and @ben for the QA sweep. If anyone sees upgrade issues, please drop a note in #devex. :rocket:
